rationale: SSJR-1.1 required manual production denial probes, a third unrelated Google account and self-authenticating browser exports. Its only setup validator hard-coded productionProvenanceAuthenticated:false, so no real run could ever earn credit. SSJR-2.0 keeps every SSJR-1.1 capability, weight and dependency unchanged and proves each capability with three layers: automated deterministic and provider-enforcement suites (including Rules emulator tests against the exact generated production Rules) that must pass on the credited production main, one validated two-device production Physical Journey pair containing the capability's milestones on both devices, and a signed owner attestation that Daniel and Nik personally played that run.

evidenceLayers.automated: Every listed suite exists at the credited production main SHA and the Validate POS20 exact-head checks and the zero-billing Firestore Rules deployment (which runs the Rules emulator suites before deploy) succeeded for production.
evidenceLayers.production-two-account: scripts/validate-ssjr-physical-journey-evidence.mjs accepts the pair (opposite roles, distinct accounts/devices/networks, one rivalry, shared session, ordered journey) and every required milestone is present on both exports.
evidenceLayers.owner-attestation: acceptance/SSJR2_OWNER_ATTESTATION_TEMPLATE.json completed by Nik with the exact statement, matching runtime and matching device labels.

zeroCreditActivities: simulated browsers, two tabs, Incognito, emulators or CI without the physical pair
creditPolicy.regressionPolicy: Append an invalidation event for a proven failed capability and all currently credited dependents; recredit requires a new validated physical run.
creditPolicy.modelChangePolicy: SSJR-2.0 is frozen. Changes require a new modelVersion with rationale.
